RewardType.title: RewardType
RewardType.description: reward type classification for bandit policies.

GateConfigPatchRequest.title: GateConfigPatchRequest
GateConfigPatchRequest.description:
a partial gate update.

a field absent from the request body is left as stored; an explicit null
clears it. `rules` is replace-in-whole — omit to keep the stored rules, send
`[]` to remove them.

context_id.title: Context Id
context_id.description: identifier the rollout hashes on; blank is evaluated as-is

GateEvaluateRequest.title: GateEvaluateRequest
GateEvaluateRequest.description: a sample context to run the gate against, without touching live traffic.

GateEvaluateResponse.title: GateEvaluateResponse
GateEvaluateResponse.description:
the gate's decision for a sample context, and why.

`eligible` is true when the bandit would select — i.e. the gate declined to
force an arm. it is deliberately not a synonym for "passed the rules": a
context outside the rollout is ineligible even with every rule matching.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identifier for the request source, e.g. a user or session id. Drives deterministic feature-gate rollout.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Named request properties, e.g. {"device": "mobile", "price": 20}. Encoded server-side against the experiment's declared context schema. This is the way to give a contextual strategy features.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Free-form key-value pairs for feature-gate targeting. Never read by the strategy itself.

vector.title: Vector
vector.description: Pre-encoded feature vector. Escape hatch for callers who already hold their own embeddings; its width must equal the experiment's dim. Prefer `properties` and let qbrix own the encoding.
